about: As a founding partner of the PayneMitchell Law Group in Dallas, Texas, attorney Andrew L. Payne devotes his practice solely to helping innocent accident victims and their families recover the damages and losses they sustained as the result of another party's negligence or wrongdoing.

Handling all types of personal injury and wrongful death claims throughout Texas and across the country, Mr. Payne advocates strongly on behalf of those he serves. Using every tool at his disposal, he works hard to secure the maximum amount of finances and compensation possible for those adversely affected by automobile and commercial vehicle accidents, aviation accidents, defective products, and other similar acts of negligence.

A highly rated and effective trial attorney, Mr. Payne holds certification in personal injury trial law from the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. In addition, the National Board of Trial Advocacy certified him in civil trial law. Mr. Payne is also a member of the American Board of Trial Advocates, an invitation-only privilege reserved for only the top 1 percent of lawyers and is a Fellow in the American College of Trial Lawyers.

Combining these credentials with his more than 25 years of practicing law, Mr. Payne possesses the skills and resources necessary to handle the demands of any client's case regardless of how complex or challenging, and over the course of his career, he has recovered millions on behalf of those in need.

Recognized for his impeccable professionalism and unwavering commitment to his clients' needs, Mr. Payne has received numerous awards and honors. "D Magazine" has selected him as one of the best lawyers in Dallas for the past 10 plus years, and "The Best Lawyers in America" named him lawyer of the year in 2015, 2019 & 2021 . He also holds an AV Preeminent peer review rating* from Martindale-Hubbell.

After graduating from Texas Christian University in 1991, Mr. Payne attended Baylor Law School, where he obtained his Juris Doctor in 1994. He received his license to practice from the State Bar of Texas that same year, and he is also licensed to practice in Arkansas and Oklahoma. In addition to his practice, he currently serves as Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law Adjunct Professor of Products Liability.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished, and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards, and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
